reviews.text: Thanks so much for the 5-stars, Ashley!
They are great !
Amazing service and team. Could not recommend them more!

Finally settled down after traveling with my dog, and one of the first things I wanted to do was leave a review for Dr. Glantz and the team at Art City Vets.

International travel with a pet involves SO much paperwork and so many little requirements, and they made the whole process much easier than I expected. Dr. Glantz was very professional, knowledgeable, and also genuinely caring with my dog. I felt like we were in good hands the entire time.

They’re definitely not the cheapest option, but honestly, I think it was worth it. For something this complicated and time-sensitive, I would rather pay a little more and know that everything is being done correctly.

I’m especially grateful because all of this meant I could bring my dog with me while I continue my studies instead of having to leave him behind. We made it safely, with no issues with the paperwork at all. Thank you Dr. Glantz and everyone at Art City Vets for helping make that possible! ❤️

The front desk staff were very pleasant! The techs and doctor were very nice and helpful. I appreciated the information, explanations and help to me preparing for my trip abroad. Dr. Wilson was very helpful and kind. I appreciated the patience and helpfulness of the staff!

Knowledgeable staff, neat facility, staff very polite and friendly to myself and my dog. Every question I asked was answered while also offering suggestions & other helpful input depending on your needs. I would highly recommend ACV. My dog has been going to ACV since he was a puppy, he's now 7 years of age. Edward Aller and there was a female name Casey, I can't remember her last name at the moment unfortunately but she was helpful and nurturing, her entire energy and demeanor was full of pleasantries. She even got my dog to eat snacks as he was reluctant to do at first. Very nurturing of my pets and accurately answered all of my inquiries
Thanks so much for the 5-stars, Brenda!

Very friendly and professional staff and doctors. I also believe having your pet's clinical story here can be particularly helpful if you need to fill in travel documents so your pet can travel overseas, because at this moment, they have 3 USDA-accredited veterinarians. As far as I know, no other vet clinic in Philly gives you so many options. The prices are toward the middle of the spectrum, but they have many specialized doctors, and I also value that the increments in price each year seem fair after considering inflation. I have been taking my pet here for 4 years and plan to continue doing it in the foreseeable future.
Thanks so much for the 5-stars, Lynda!
Super friendly and helpful staff! Clean environment!
Very great place very knowledgeable and helpful

I can't speak to the quality of the medical team here, but the administrative side needs help. The cancellation policy -- requiring you to affirmatively contact the clinic to confirm an appointment you had already scheduled, and do it two days in advance, or your appointment is cancelled without further notice -- is customer-unfriendly at best. And not even offering to reschedule is a good way to say "we don't care to have you come back." So I won't.
Thanks so much for the 5-stars, Eva!

The staff at the front desk were very nice and helpful. We had about a 10-15 minute wait past our appointment time. The doctor and the tech who took care of us were very knowledgeable and took the time to answer my questions. I did not feel rushed at all. Overall it was a very good experience and Art City Vets will be our new primary care vet.
Thanks so much for the 5-stars, Krista!
Thanks for treating my old girl so well!! Love this place: never waiting long, full explanation of treatment options, and the attention to detail is so refreshing. Thank you for listening & caring!

I've been coming to ArtCity Vets for 6 years now. I've since moved from the area but will still come back to them due to the quality provided.  Dr Glantz is exceptional. His data driven approach to care has helped me figure out my dogs nutritional needs and create a better life for her.

We cannot praise Art City Vets enough for the outstanding care the whole team provided our dachshund in the last several years of his life. We actually previously brought him to another veterinary clinic, and we were very happy with his care there. But during an emergency with him, we brought him to the Art City Vets Urgent Care center. The care he received during that urgent care visit was so excellent that we switched to bringing him to Art City Vets for all his veterinary needs.

Our dog has always had significant anxiety about vets. In his urgent care visit, they went way above and beyond to make him comfortable. They took us to our own separate room with a closed door, they set up soft bedding for him to rest on, they provided us treats and water, and then as much as possible we had our conversations over the phone so that he wasn't anxious around the vet. Further, their diagnostics were extremely thorough. They identified health concerns that clearly had been developing for a long time, and were therefore not caught by either of the last two vets he saw.

For wellness visits, the attention to making him comfortable was just as robust as at the urgent care center. And the resources they provided, as well as the detailed after-visit summaries following each visit, gave me lots to consider for how to increase his quality of life -- way above and beyond just checking to ensure he's in generally good shape once a year.

2 months ago he was diagnosed with a tumor and we were told he had 1-3 months to live. We could not have asked for a better partner during this incredibly difficult time than Art City Vets. A special shoutout to Dr. Georgia Christensen, who provided holistic guidance, even outside of operating business hours, to help us think through decisions when we were an emotional mess. As painful as it was, he eventually had a peaceful passing. We cannot thank the whole Art City Vets team enough for your support and guidance in his final days, and for helping him to live such a rich, full life when he was with us.

The staff are always friendly and helpful. They know Lily is still new to life here in America, and is reactive to dogs other than greyhounds. They put us in an exam room right away for everyone's benefit. Dr Carmellini is wonderful, and so good with both Lily and my husband. I am very happy with our new vet clinic since moving nearby from South Philly. The ladies at the front desk on both sides of the street (Wellness & Urgent Care) are always super nice and helpful. Dr Carmellini has a calm demeanor, considerate and explains things well (in terms even my husband understands). Compassionate, knowledgeable, treat us like family.
good for pet

Art city vets has many experienced vets and techs on staff.  Their urgent care location means in an emergency some one can see your pet.  The pharmacy is on the premises so you don’t have to order online or wait.  I have had excellent experience with all the vets I have used.  My pets problems were identified and treated so they are doing well.

Everyone on staff is great. From booking the appointment to receiving care. Dr Shafer is wonderful. I fully trust her with my cat care. Dr Krause is also a great vet. Everyone on staff was very kind and understanding when I had to put my cat to sleep.
Greta service and information! The doctor was patient and knowledgeable! Great care from the doctor!

Had such a great first visit with Dr. Glantz! He was thorough and reassuring, answered all of my questions, clearly loves animals, and was just great overall. The tech was also awesome, reviewing vaccine timelines and feeding Odette pupperoni during her shots (she approved!). Staff also was just so welcoming and kind

This was my first visit since moving to the city. Everyone was so friendly and welcoming Everyone I spoke to was lovely. This was a great experience and I will definitely be back How kind everyone was

I've visited this place twice, and honestly, the staff is incredibly friendly, attentive, and very professional. I always feel comfortable there; and even though I don't speak English very well, they made everything I needed easy. I recommend this place 100%. ✨✨✨🙏🏼💫 My thanks to Zachary Glantz for the explanation and for every detail he explained so clearly, which made organizing my pets' trip so much easier. Absolutely all the staff.

Dr. Christensen and the vet tech working with her were fantastic with my cats. One of them is extremely nervous and skittish and they were so gentle and calming with her - we even managed to get her nails clipped. Both cats had a seamless visit.  Thanks for taking such great care of them.

Art City vets are wonderful. The staff is caring, knowledgeable, and efficient. Not only do they care for pets, but they also show them affection and love. Art City Vet staff also care for owners and treat them with respect.  Dr.Schaefer and Dr. Xie are fabulous.

I’m seriously impressed by this vet. Not only are they very reasonably priced but they REALLY care about my pets. My cat suddenly started closing her 3rd eyelids for no apparent reason, they continue to reach out to me to ask me questions and follow up after the visit to make sure shes doing ok and to make sure she hasn’t gotten worse. They definitely pay close attention to their clients. After our last vet misplaced my cat’s urine sample then practically abandoned us in a room for 2 hours, it’s like night and day. Please choose Art City Vets. They CARE. THEY REALLY CARE!!
Thank you for the 5-star review!
They are so attentive and loving to your pet, that even they feel safe. The team is patient and takes the time to walk you through everything!

After struggling to find a vet in the city I trust for my cats, I am so glad I found art city. They are transparent about pricing (which I’ve found out the hard way other places are not) and they truly put care of your animal over everything else. I would highly recommend this practice!!!
Thank you for the 5-stars!

Have been going to ACV since I adopted my cat last June. Facility is clean, scheduling an appointment (whether for wellness or urgent care) has always been easy, with their staff always being kind and patient (especially as a first time pet owner). I particularly want to shoutout Dr Christensen. Thank you for your care for Nora :) we will see you at the next annual!
My experience at art city vets was fantastic great staff and their dedication to helping the fur babies get better is wonderful I love this vet
Our first visit since moving to the neighborhood and it was outstanding.
Great staff. Takes great care of my buddy!

They are so gentle with my baby, she was so distracted by the Churu they gave her that she didn’t even notice she got a vaccine. They are efficient and kind, and I don’t feel like they overcharge or push extra unnecessary stuff. I also really appreciate the plants and decor.
Art City vets is so sweet and patient with my anxious dog and I really appreciate them! Patience and genuine care for animals

Staff was very sensitive to my very anxious pet (and her owner). Problem solved to make visit as stress free as possible. I am so appreciative of their skill and caring. The veterinarian who filled in for Dr. Glantz, who was called to an emergency surgery, and the technician who was heroic in holding my dog. excellent care for my high anxiety pet

Very easy to schedule an appointment. The waiting room was clean and well organized. I really enjoyed the free seltzers. I do not recall her name but the vet tech I had at my appointment was a lovely person! Doctor and vet tech were very nice to my dog and very knowledgeable
Thank you for the 5-star review!

I've been very happy with the care my senior cat is receiving. Dr. Shafer and Dr. Christensen have both been very helpful. I appreciate the time taken to explain her diagnosis (what we know, what we don't) and her treatment plan.
Thank you for your rating, Maxine!
The vets and staff here are the most professional, thorough and friendly I've ever encountered at a vet's.

Charlie -Cat and I love Art City and we are super grateful for the 5/6 years of care my girl has received. See y'all at next year's annual. chEErs😻🐾
We appreciate Y'all's sincere love for our pets. Thank U Art City Vets …
Thank you so much for your 5-star review, Anita!
Knowledgeable friendly vet made my cat comfortable. Good visit lots of information. Thorough and caring exam
Thanks for the five-star rating, Renee! We’re glad you had a great experience.

This was my cat’s visit to the clinic, and the overall experience was very positive. The reception staff were very kind and welcoming, and the waiting area was clean, comfortable, and well organized. The veterinary professionals provided excellent care — they listened carefully and took into account that Rosetta had previously been treated in another country, with different processes and protocols. The exam room was also clean and orderly, and the entire visit felt well guided, organized, and smooth from start to finish.
Incredible as always. Dr. Xie is fantastic and I trust her with my boys" life Dr. Xie is incredible!! The expertise, connection, and thoughtfulness

We are so lucky to have Art City Vets in our area. The staff is always helpful, caring, knowledgeable, and patient. They are quick to return calls and e-mails and always go the extra mile to provide great care.

Very comprehensive exam, the vet discussed all possible causes for my dog's cough and how to approach treatment. My only criticism is they recommend a lot of additional tests, some of which seem excessive. For example, testing for fecal parasites when my dog is showing zero symptoms and is getting a medication that eliminates fecal parasites anyway as part of the heartworm regiment. I understand they must mention everything to avoid liability, but I felt pressured into additional services in a way that not all other vets do. However, I was able to make an appointment within a week and the front desk is very efficient. Even the best vet can be ruined by poor service in the front. Art City gives good care AND good service.

I’ve been bringing both my dogs to art city since 2021 and am so grateful to have a vet that I love and trust. Their front desk staff are always efficient and friendly, the spaces throughout the office are always clean and bright and I’ve had a great experience with every vet and vet tech that has seen my dogs. They are also transparent about pricing, and easy to work with when it comes to administrative tasks. I also love the peace of mind in knowing that I can go to their emergency center that already has my dogs health history on file for quicker and easier treatment in case of emergencies. Your pets are in good hands at art city!!

We bring all of our cats to Art City Vets and are always very satisfied with the level of professionalism, expertise and compassion received by all team members. We recommend Art City Vets to other pet parents regularly. This is a difficult question to answer but the veterinarians at Art City are the best we have worked with in the Philadelphia area. The rest of your team is amazing as well. We most appreciate the compassion shown for our concerns and pets.
I have used Art City Vets before and everyone is always friendly and the vets are great. I love the cat waiting area! Competent friendly staff!

I've brought my pet to Art City Vets a few times and have had a positive experience each time. Most recently, we had another positive visit. The staff was friendly and helped me identify clear next steps for addressing my pet's health issue. All staff members I met with were great. This included front desk staff, vet, and vet assistant.

Update: I filed a formal complaint against one of the vets because of his actions. One of the vets REFUSED to let me talk to the vet who had seen my cat and then illegally closed my account before I had obtained another vet. Buyer BEWARE!!

Do not recommend at all. While they have some good vets, other vets are solely focused on how much money they can get out of you.
Great staff.
Too expensive for the services provided but friendly staff.

I brought my dog here it’s very clean and nice the staff is friendly. Everything was clean and everyone was kind and respectful.
I had an issue with some of the medication prices. I was not informed about a dispensing fee, which I would not have had a problem with if it was explained to me at the time.
I was impressed that they did reach out to address this. They took the time to explain their policies and it was very helpful.
If you do want to go to an outside pharmacy you should be aware that you will need to fill out a form that will authorize it to that pharmacy.
Great location to bring your pets. The staff seems like they really care for animals and the community too. I almost always recommend this place to my friends and neighbors in the Brewrytown area.

Amazing veterinarians and staff! Extremely helpful and it seems that every employee really cares about your animal and your experience. They don't price gouge like so many in philly and never had a bad experience

When I thought there was no hope, art City bets wellness center showed me a different path. My dog once upon a Time had four legs and because of art City vets she lives as a tripod. Without their assistance their referral their doctors and their staff. My daughter, my dog Scarlett was given a second chance.
And it could have been her last chance without them. If you're ever looking for someone who has not just a heart that beats for one but beats for many please stop by art City event take your loving furry Friends companions, love partners they are there to help and assist by all means necessary.

¡SCAM ALERT!
Resubmitting a review because this business somehow got my first review removed. I brought my dog in after his paw got cut at the park near this location. They came in and told me he would need stitches and that the could not see the wound without sedating my dog. I was surprised how they were recommending stitches without seeing the wound, and asked to see my dogZ They brought him back in a whole 20 minutes after entering the urgent care with the wound still open, unclean and unbandaged. This time the vet said my dog would not need stitches but would need his nail removed. I asked for a cost estimate and the vet left the room for another 20 minutes while my dog was still bleeding and no one cared to even clean him up after paying $140. I realized this place is a scam and they are preying on people’s emotions to make money. Additionally, I submitted a review to which they replied lying that he was bandaged. This is false and I have pictures at the vet to prove it, which I’ll be happy to submit again if my review is lied to or removed under false pretenses. Total scam of a vet.

I’ve taken my fur baby two art city twice. I have moved around a few times in the city and tried other vets but I always end up here. The front desk is always pleasant and they are all very educated and seem to genuinely enjoy their work. It’s a bit out of the way but if it means putting my pet in the best hands of care, I’ll take the trip.

All of my pets go to Art City Vet and we love them! I have a very feisty cat who they love and accommodate incredibly. They helped come up with a plan to make her more calm and comfortable.
My dog can be dog selective and other dogs can make her anxious or lash out. They came up with a medication plan and have us call when we arrive so they can clear the waiting room for us, whether it’s a sick visit or a well visit. While I felt other vets sometimes would judge our pets for being a little more difficult at the vet, Art City loves and appreciates pets of all temperaments and treats them with love and care.
The doctors are all price conscious and always try to choose the most cost effective and least invasive treatment options. Cost effective alternatives are always presented when possible and their services are reasonably priced. They are very transparent about their prices and will answer any cost questions prior to the visit.
All of the doctors and staff are patient, knowledgeable, and kind. Both locations are clean. Parking can be tricky, but it’s doable and worth the effort.

Very fair pricing and an excellent staff! As a first time dog owner, I feel so much better knowing our dog has such an amazing and caring vet team that we take her to. Seriously could not recommend them enough.
This place is staffed with amazing individuals that make the whole experience easy and efficient. The vets are knowledgeable and answer all our questions about of fur babies.
Thank you for giving Art City Vets 5 Stars!

Everyone at Art City Vets cares very deeply about what they do. We are happy that we have such a wonderful practice near our home and that all of our needs are met when we come there. We are grateful to everyone who works at Art City Vets. Dr. Thomas has been wonderful with Gilly and has been helping us navigate his difficult journey with allergies. On many occasions whenever we have concerns or questions the staff at Art City Vets has been available for us to talk to. We truly appreciate it more than we can express. Thank you Dr. Wilson for helping us make sure Rambo is healthy and happy. We are also grateful to everyone who works at the emergency services across the street for when we have needed to come in and for taking time to take care of our little guys. Thank you all so much. You've all been so wonderful to us! Thank you for your keen eye when dealing with patients who are not able to talk to you about what's bothering them.

Staff gave so much love toy big guy Jackson. He sure appreciated it. Dr. Morgan Shafer is a gem and my cat and I are grateful to know her. EVERYONE I dealt with deserves recognition for making our visit so enjoyable. Total love, care and understanding.
Incredible vet! They are so caring with all of the pets, and really help you decide the best option for your pet. I would never take my dog anywhere else.

I LOVE art city vets. My 115lb dog is so nervous to go to the vet (even with anxiety meds!) and art city is the only place I've been to out of 3+ vets that are gentle and patient with him. You all are amazing. THANK YOU for treating every being with kindness.
Top care, service and knowledge.
The entirety of the staff is so helpful and knowledgeable, and it doesn’t feel like I’m being gouged unlike other vet offices. They handled my cat with so much care and attention!

I cannot recommend this veterinary practice highly enough.

Dr. Aller saved my pet from unnecessary suffering and saved me thousands of dollars when another vet told me my pet needed invasive surgery. Dr. Aller took the time to thoroughly examine my pet and discovered what was really going on - preventing both the trauma of an unneeded operation and the financial burden that would have come with it.

Even after moving 2 hours away from Philadelphia, I continued to make the drive to bring my cats here for both wellness visits and urgent care because the quality of service, compassion, and expertise are unmatched.

Recently, as I've been preparing for an international move, Dr. Shafer and Dr. Glantz have been incredibly helpful and understanding throughout this complex process. They've gone above and beyond to ensure my pets' medical records are properly prepared and have provided invaluable guidance for the transition.

Honestly, why haven't I been coming here earlier? I was at another vet but this practice seems like the place to be!

have 3 cats and called ahead 15 minute before my appointment to request a room since they get nervous around dogs and the team (lily specifically) was so welcoming!

I originally saw Dr. P but she is away so I saw Dr. Carmellini who is the most kind person out there! She was able to answer all my questions during our annual visit and even answered questions for me that I hadn't even thought about! I'm so grateful for the vets here and I can tell that my fur babies will be well taken care of. Lily (front desk). Holy moly, you were busy and you were still helping everyone out! Go girl! Thank you for making sure our pets got a room to chill out in while taking every email and call in!

Ryan (tech). You're so nice! Thank you for being so kind to our pets. You were paper charting that day so as someone who has done that before... go you!!
Dr. Carmellini, you're awesome. So well educated and well informed! How absolutely sweet everyone is! Lily at the front desk, Ryan our tech and Dr. Carmellini were so awesome.

This veterinarian has done the best job with my dog! She used to disappear for weeks without a trace but my wife seems to always be calm. For some reason after every disappearance I would wake up the next day to find my wife sleeping with bird feathers in her lips. I let it go for a while but as it kept happening coincidentally I had to ask her why she and the dog were never together. Then I found out she was a werewolf! So naturally I took her to Art City Vets for rabies shots etc. so far we are doing good but wouldn’t you just imagine, turns out I’m a Vampire! Guess I know where I’m going for my rabies shots when I’m in bat form.

Happy Halloween all!

Dr. Amanda Carmellini and Veterinary Technician Cynthia at Art City Vets are absolute gems! My cat, Opal, is very anxious and sometimes has accidents, but they showed so much compassion and patience. They went above and beyond to make both of us feel comfortable, and I truly felt that Opal was in the best hands. I highly recommend!

Ooops, updating a prior review because I got appointments mixed up!

Dr. Fagan saw our cat for an exam and pre-surgical intake. She was so thoughtful and meticulous. She went over her findings of each body system patiently and throughly. I was nervous about our cat receiving anesthesia, but she took the time to answer my questions and assuage my concerns. She provided a clear description of what a dental would entail. I left the appointment feeling confident and ready for the next steps. Not to mention, my cat absolutely ADORES her, and he's an anxious boy who is typically scared at the vet. He was PURRING, drooling, and didn't even want to go back into his carrier which is normally his safe space!
Thank you for the 5-star review, Janessa. We hope that you, Coven, Noodle, and Roux are all doing well!

I was nervous to bring my cat, Dusty, here because she's terrified of strangers and especially the vet but they were great! Dr. Thomas and the assistant (sorry I forgot her name) treated my cat so gentle and nice! The entire staff seemed very caring and tried to help her feel more safe when she was yelling in the waiting room. Dusty ended up being diagnosed with a UTI and I was able to get meds for that and tapeworms right there. Dr. Thomas answered all my questions and made sure I knew what my options were. Now we're back at home and Dusty doesn't even seem traumatized! Yay!

The front desk staff, vet tech, and the vet were so kind and helpful! Dr. Carmellini was thorough with my cat's care and explained everything in a way that assuaged my worries! I feel at ease knowing my senior kitty is in good hands.
Can't say enough about the positiveities! Kind, caring,  compassionate and patient!! My Calli Girl was sick and I was afraid she wasn't gonna make it.  But,  everyone was so compassionate.
I couldn't be happier with the care my dog receives at ACV. Convenience

We have brought both of our dogs for care here and have received great communication from the staff. Today was our first time bringing our older dog who has some dog aggression issues, but we let the staff know before coming in, (pup was muzzled) they noticed us quickly in the waiting room and helped us sign in and brought us back to an exam room. Thanks for making it easy and stress free!  Communication and responsiveness is top notch!
Thank you for the 5-star review Angel!

I used this vet since 2018 and recently switched due to moving - after a not so great experience at another vet I feel compelled to write how great my experience was here. They are very clean, organized, responsive, and professional.
Service was great, as always!! How kind you are, knowledge, and how you treat my little ones!
Wonderful confident caring accurate veterinarians. My babies are very well taken care at this vets. Clinic.
Excellent and very caring staff!

I had a fantastic visit at Art City vets. The office and medical staff were friendly, kind, accommodating, knowledgable, efficient, and caring. They welcomed my cat and I and answered all of my questions to provide fantastic medical care. Sophia Fagan Your good listening
Such great staff for my nervous cat! Will definitely recommend! They were very knowledgeable and also helped us find the most cost efficient medication for our needs
Everyone was extremely kind, Dr. Tran very kindly fit in an appointment for the kitten I found the day of!

On time, friendly, clean and knowledgeable. Took time to answer questions and cared about animals. Vet assistant was very nice and took great care of cats. Front desk was also super friendly and helpful when figuring out my philasd discount.

We had our first visit at Art City Vets last week, where they saw my two Shelties for their annual wellness exam. The wait was short, and everyone we interacted with with knowledgable, patient, kind, and professional. We loved our tech (I'm sorry I forgot your name!) and Dr. Tran was amazing. We're so happy to call Art City Vets our new home for vet care!

We have brought our two kitties since 2022 and they have been wonderful! The team at Art City Vets is extremely polite, understanding, delicate, and have always gone above and beyond with our kitties. Their urgent care is right across the street as well! Thank you!!
Everyone at ACV is incredibly kind and caring. They made our nervous pup very comfortable and took great care.

I took my cat here for a wellness visit. Everyone was very nice and the doctor was helpful and knowledgeable. They treated my cat with patience and were gentle with him. With all of the basic bloodwork & tests the visit came out to $590. They do not offer payment plans here. There is a surcharge for credit cards and is better if you can use debit. Overall a good experience.

Clean office and helpful front desk. The vet tech and Dr. Thomas made us feel welcome and comfortable and included in Beans' treatment process, which is not always the case at some vets. We really appreciated the invitation for us to ask questions and not be rushed.

We love Art City Vets so much! We have been a bunch recently because we just got a rescue dog so he has some issues we are figuring out as we get to know him. They are so patient and knowledgable with us and our boy and have really helped us get be the best parents for him. Our dog is shy and anxious but they make him feel so comfortable that he loves coming back. Every vet we've seen there has been amazing, most recently we saw Morgan and Amanda who we loved. We also love the techs, Levia P especially at our last appointment was so sweet and thorough and great with our boy. Caring and amazing staff, really supportive of our buddy's needs and dedicated to making it a positive experience for him! Thank you!

Everything was great. The doctor was extremely patient with my cat who ended up getting very stressed out - panting, hissing, the whole 9-yards. In addition, everyone at the front desk was SO nice and very friendly - they just overall made me feel comfortable and welcome.

I was very impressed with how much time Dr. Glantz spent explaining everything we might need to know, including problems we might encounter and how to handle them if we do. I wish all vets and human doctors were as thoughtful and thorough.
Friendly staff, very clean, and great service. Dr. Zemanian was great! Very friendly and knowledgeable. She is always thorough with my cat and very gentle.
Everything went smoothly and fast. Everyone from the receptionist to the doctor were very polite, nice and professional.

Had a great first time experience here as a first time dog owner. The technician, vet, and front desk reception were incredibly kind, helpful, did a thorough exam on my puppy. Happy to have found a great vet!
All the staff are very friendly, kind and respectful with us. I strongly recommend Art city Vets The staff take the time to explain all the details about my questions
Thank you for the 5-Star review, Brandon! We are happy to hear that you had a positive experience with us. Please let us know if you need anything in the future!

The staff was kind and professional. They treated my cat gently and with affection. The vet and her assistant, really liked them. They didn't make disparaging comments about my cat and try to upsell me on vitamins and things he doesn't need, or more tests.
Art City Vets staff members are friendly, thorough, and extremely knowledgeable.  I really appreciate this : )
Just started taking my dog to Art Cit Vets so it's still early on in our experience, but so far everyone has been warm, knowledgeable, and patient.

I had a fantastic experience with this practice! I'm so glad that this is a fear free certified practice. It shows. Everyone was kind, helpful, and knowledgable. Every member of the staff from the front desk workers, the vet tech, and Dr. Keely Zhang made me feel empowered me to make confident decisions about my cats' care.

I have 2 kitties that I bring here now for wellness visits, and one of them had dental surgery here.  I switched here from a previous veterinarian.
I never had to wait long in the office or for an appointment. The dental surgery my one kitty had went great and smooth recovery. I feel they really care about my fur babies!

I couldn't be happier with the care my cat received at Art City Vets. I have used them for years for all of my pets and I've always had an amazing experience. Everyone is great. On our last visit Dr. Carmellini was our vet and she was amazing! She was so easy to talk to, explained everything in an in-depth and understandable way, and answered every question we had. Our vet tech and the receptionist were also great. I've met them both before on previous visits and they are always incredibly kind and personable.

Very acclimating to our cat, letting us stay in a room where it was quiet. Service was very quick and everyone was super nice, and the vets we have seen have been so friendly and explained everything very well.

My dog has been a patient at Art City since before I adopted her! I wish I remembered the vet tech's name who helped me but she was SO accommodating to my anxious/reactive pittie mix! She even went across the street to the urgent care to grab my dog's medications so I didn't have to deal with my dog seeing other pets. Easily the best vet I've taken a pet to, would 10000% recommend!

I was very nervous and concerned about my cat's health and the staff were so supportive during the visits and continued to answer all my questions via email days later.
